items.title: Resolve Codex adapter verify command from available wrappers
items.context: Update codex-adapter evidence summaries and REVIEW preflight rendering so missing/failing/stale evidence recommends an existing local command: lattice-codex when present, otherwise koala-codex, lattice.js, koala.js, or documented global-thin fallback. Must cover legacy wrapper-only and lattice wrapper cases.
items.userSees: REVIEW→TEST CLI gate preflight shows `run: node bin/koala-codex.js verify_codex` in a legacy repo that has bin/koala-codex.js and lacks bin/lattice-codex.js; it does not print `run: node bin/lattice-codex.js verify_codex` for that repo.

happy.desc: In a repo containing bin/lattice-codex.js, summarizeCodexEvidence and rendered REVIEW preflight recommend `node bin/lattice-codex.js verify_codex`.

edge.desc: In a legacy repo containing bin/koala-codex.js but no bin/lattice-codex.js, missing/failing/stale Codex evidence recommends `node bin/koala-codex.js verify_codex` and never recommends the absent wrapper.

adversarial.desc: renderPreflight and phase-gate failure hints must not bypass the resolved command by using the stale LOCAL_CODEX_VERIFY_COMMAND label.

verificationEvidence.note: Regression covers a lattice-wrapper temp repo and asserts missing evidence remediates with node bin/lattice-codex.js verify_codex.
Legacy temp repo contains bin/koala-codex.js and asserts missing evidence remediates with node bin/koala-codex.js verify_codex.
Preflight/evidence summary assertions consume resolved commands instead of the stale LOCAL_CODEX_VERIFY_COMMAND label.

items.title: Make worktree acceptance guidance prefer current worktree CLI
items.context: Strengthen runtime/preflight/docs guidance so story worktree acceptance points to node bin/lattice.js or node packages/main/dist/cli.js for current code, and labels bare global lattice as heartbeat/post-merge main fallback when it may lag the worktree.
items.userSees: When a Koala/Lattice self-development story worktree is using current code, docs and diagnostics say `node bin/lattice.js <command>` or `node packages/main/dist/cli.js <command>` for status/validate/gate evidence, and any global `lattice` that resolves outside the worktree is described as `heartbeat-only, not current-worktree gate/status evidence`.

happy.desc: Bootstrap/docs guidance for current story worktrees names local wrapper or current dist CLI as the evidence path for status/validate/gate checks.

edge.desc: When global @koala-agent/core resolves outside current worktree, diagnostics keep the result advisory and describe global CLI as heartbeat-only rather than current-worktree evidence.

adversarial.desc: The implementation must not hard-fail all global lattice drift or force global lattice to point at a story worktree.

items.title: Add focused regression tests and delivery evidence
items.context: Add smoke/unit coverage for both resolver behavior and stale-global guidance, then run the focused Lattice CLI validation set without reintroducing Swift/Mac Native App validation.
items.userSees: Focused verification output includes passing Node/Lattice commands such as `npm run test:codex-assets`, `npm run test:entrypoints`, and a JSON stdout parse check; no delivery evidence command is `swift test` or Mac Native App validation.

happy.desc: Focused tests cover lattice wrapper and legacy wrapper command resolution, and pass after the implementation.

edge.desc: Focused tests cover stale-global/current-worktree guidance without depending on global install mutation.

adversarial.desc: Validation evidence must preserve JSON stdout parseability and must not include Swift/Mac Native App fallback commands.
